Generated: 2026-07-06 01:45:28

Purpose:
Check whether an Uploaded Document Unified Content layer already exists.

Corrected architecture:
The upload document article path should use the same article content extracted from the editor.
It should NOT perform document cleaning.
It should NOT depend on phrase extraction.
It should package extracted article content into a unified uploaded-document format before UUCD.

We are looking for:
- uploaded_document_unified_content
- upload unified content store
- conversion from UploadExtractionResult / editor article content
- fields like doc_id, document_id, workspace_id, title, h1, headings, article_text/body_text/html/text, metadata
- handoff toward UUCD

7. VERIFICATION 6D DECISION TEMPLATE
============================================================

To approve 6D, we must find or create a layer that:

[ ] Receives uploaded article/editor content from extractor or upload route
[ ] Preserves the same extracted article content
[ ] Stores/packages uploaded document article content in a unified format
[ ] Includes workspace_id
[ ] Includes doc_id or document_id
[ ] Includes original filename/source metadata
[ ] Includes format/source_type
[ ] Includes title/H1/headings where available
[ ] Includes article body/text/html where available
[ ] Does NOT clean/rewrite article text
[ ] Does NOT depend on phrase extraction
[ ] Does NOT perform semantic analysis
[ ] Does NOT create final UUCD directly unless it is explicitly the 6E stage

Decision:
- APPROVE if an Uploaded Document Unified Content layer already exists and meets these requirements.
- PATCH if a partial layer exists.
- BUILD if no dedicated layer exists.
